items.text: On December 21, Walt Disney's Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, the first feature-length animated cartoon with sound, premiered and became a smash hit.
items.question: Who took you to see Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, and which picture house was it?
items.source_quote: December 21 – Walt Disney's Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, the first feature-length animated cartoon with sound, is premiered and becomes a smash hit.

items.text: Postage for a domestic letter was 3 cents an ounce.
items.question: Where were you living when a stamp for a letter cost three cents, and who did you write to?

items.text: Bing Crosby introduced Sweet Leilani in the film Waikiki Wedding, and his record of it was listed among the popular records of 1937 in the United States.
items.question: Did you see Waikiki Wedding at the pictures or hear Bing Crosby's record of Sweet Leilani, and who were you with?
source_quote: "Sweet Leilani" w.m. Harry Owens. Introduced by Bing Crosby in the film Waikiki Wedding
The twenty popular records in the United States listed below

items.text: On May 27, the Golden Gate Bridge in California opened to pedestrian traffic, and the next day President Franklin D. Roosevelt pushed a button in Washington, D.C., to start vehicle traffic across it.
items.question: Do you remember the first time you saw a picture of the Golden Gate Bridge, or crossed it yourself, and who was with you?
items.source_quote: May 27 – In California, the Golden Gate Bridge opens to pedestrian traffic, creating a vital link between San Francisco and Marin County. The next day, President Franklin D. Roosevelt pushes a button in Washington, D.C., signaling the start of vehicle traffic over the Golden Gate Bridge.

items.text: On July 5, the Hormel company introduced the canned precooked meat product Spam.
items.question: Do you remember the first time Spam came to your table, and who in your house cooked it?
items.source_quote: July 5 – The canned precooked meat product Spam is introduced by the Hormel company.
